latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Article to Video AI — convert written articles into ready-to-share videos.

- Upload articles (TXT, DOCX, PDF, or URL, up to 200MB) and generate 1080p MP4 videos with visuals and voiceover.
- Automatic narrated video creation: just describe your desired result in plain language.
- Simple authentication with 100 free credits for new users (via NEMO_TOKEN).
- Works with most common document types; provides quick, cloud-based processing (about 1-2 minutes per video).
- Includes session management, credit checking, on-demand exports, and timeline tracking for easy editing and iteration.
